description: This file defines a custom guardrail class 'myCustomGuardrail' that extends 'CustomGuardrail' with hooks for pre-call, moderation, and post-call processing in an LLM API context. It includes logic for masking sensitive words and rejecting responses based on content.

classes.name: myCustomGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class extending 'CustomGuardrail' with hooks for input modification, moderation, and response validation.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook that masks occurrences of 'litellm' in message contents before sending to the LLM.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Moderation hook that rejects calls if 'litellm' is detected in message contents.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-call hook that raises an exception if the response contains the word 'coffee'.
